1320170.shortDescription: Vigila la playa, reacciona rápido y salva vidas usando quads, motos de agua y drones. Patrulla la bahía, ayuda a quienes lo necesitan y descubre una intriga criminal oculta bajo las olas.
1320170.shortDescriptionEn: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quad bikes, jet skis, and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need, and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

1447650.shortDescription: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.
1447650.shortDescriptionEn: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

2121910.shortDescription: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.
2121910.shortDescriptionEn: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.

2231090.shortDescription: Number Machine es un juego de automatización y fábricas de mundo abierto con mecánicas matemáticas. Diseña, construye y optimiza fábricas que ensamblan y entregan automáticamente complejas estructuras numéricas. Inspirado en Opus Magnum e Infinifactory.
2231090.shortDescriptionEn: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

2431590.shortDescription: Asume el papel de un mecánico de naves estelares y salda la inmensa deuda que dejó tu padre. Fabrica componentes, construye naves estelares y acepta contratos de facciones. Sigue los eventos a través de la galaxia y paga la deuda antes de la fecha límite.
2431590.shortDescriptionEn: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.

2450350.shortDescription: ¡Guerra de duendes 16 contra 16! Roba sombreros, asedia castillos, rescata a tu princesa regordeta y engorda a la enemiga con carne deliciosa. Desbloquea sombreros y clases y vuelve a la carga una y otra vez en un PvP absurdo y caótico.
2450350.shortDescriptionEn: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

2483700.shortDescription: HARMA es un juego de construcción de mazos roguelike de alta dificultad que combina una historia dura con una experiencia de juego extremadamente desafiante. Los demonios están destruyendo este mundo. Lucha contra los males del mundo en un destino irracional. Y demuestra que estuviste aquí.
2483700.shortDescriptionEn: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

2526880.shortDescription: Prepara tus defensas durante el día y sobrevive hasta el amanecer. Defender bros es un juego de Defensa de Torres Roguelike en el que juegas como un soldado que defiende su base. Elige entre varias habilidades aleatorias para ganar poderes especiales y sobrevivir a la noche.
2526880.shortDescriptionEn: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger

2547010.shortDescription: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.
2547010.shortDescriptionEn: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.

2551970.shortDescription: Vive el inicio de una gran aventura en Outcast Tales: The First Journey. Libra combates donde prima la estrategia, toma decisiones difíciles y escoge tus propias aventuras: ¡escribe la historia de tu grupo de marginados!
2551970.shortDescriptionEn: The game is not Free-to-Play, it's genuinely free. It's a challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions.

2594620.shortDescription: Coge tu cuaderno de bocetos, relájate, explora y dibuja en tu propio Figure Drawing Garden: un jardín virtual inmersivo diseñado para que practiques y mejores el dibujo de la figura humana.
2594620.shortDescriptionEn: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

2660460.shortDescription: ¡Construye y pilota tu propio avión! Completa misiones para ganar dinero, mejora tu avión y descubre nuevas ubicaciones en un mundo abierto.
2660460.shortDescriptionEn: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

2669450.shortDescription: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.
2669450.shortDescriptionEn: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

2670430.shortDescription: Dashoot es un juego de plataformas de precisión en pixel art. Dispara a interruptores y mueve plataformas con tu cañón flotante. Recoge objetos para impulsos con distintas cargas, direcciones y distancias. Traza rutas subterráneas, reactiva centrales y descubre los secretos de la IA Deus.
2670430.shortDescriptionEn: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

2725250.shortDescription: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.
2725250.shortDescriptionEn: A 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

2742720.shortDescription: Siguiendo los pasos de una madre a la que nunca conoció, Lena intenta triunfar como bailarina en la ciudad. Atrapada en una disputa entre compañías de danza, lidiando con el amor, el desamor y los retos de la juventud, también debe batallar con la voz en su cabeza que comenta todo lo que hace.
2742720.shortDescriptionEn: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?

2784470.shortDescription: Levanta tu imperio en este trepidante constructor de reinos roguelike. Libra cruentas batallas contra tus homónimos rivales. Explota las mecánicas con cientos de construcciones increíbles para convertirte en el rey de reyes.
2784470.shortDescriptionEn: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

2793540.shortDescription: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.
2793540.shortDescriptionEn: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

2847780.shortDescription: Prende tu espada y explora las torres más altas y los rincones más oscuros de una isla olvidada que se extinguió hace mucho tiempo.
2847780.shortDescriptionEn: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

2860490.shortDescription: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!
2860490.shortDescriptionEn: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

2938980.shortDescription: Tus decisiones tienen consecuencias, y pueden hacer daño a mucha gente. ¿Podrás salvar a tus amigos... o al menos salvarte del horror que te espera?
2938980.shortDescriptionEn: Go on an adventure with your friends to the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital and uncover its secrets. Can you save your friends or at least save yourself from the horror that awaits?

2991650.shortDescription: Dawn es una película de animación que te sumerge en el corazón de una historia oscura. Un piloto de caza dispuesto a todo para vengarse. Un cóctel explosivo de combates aéreos, música épica y una historia cautivadora.
2991650.shortDescriptionEn: Dawn is an animated film that plunges you into the heart of a dark story. A fighter pilot, ready to do anything for revenge. An explosive cocktail of dogfights, epic music and a gripping story.

3008180.shortDescription: ¡La estrategia por turnos se une al Roguelike! Disfruta de suerte y táctica, crea tu propio conjunto de habilidades, enfrenta enemigos variados, descubre poderosos dispositivos y salva el mundo.
3008180.shortDescriptionEn: Turn-based strategy meets Roguelike adventure! Enjoy a mix of luck and tactics. Build a unique skill set, battle various enemies, discover powerful devices, and save the world!

3010170.shortDescription: Híncale el diente a Fangtopia, un acogedor y relajante juego de rompecabezas en el que construyes paisajes terroríficamente paradisíacos con casillas de terreno para simpáticos monstruos. Crea un mundo que dé escalofríos de pura ternura sin preocupaciones ni sustos.
3010170.shortDescriptionEn: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.

3014860.shortDescription: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?
3014860.shortDescriptionEn: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

3024120.shortDescription: Eletta es un juego de acción y aventura travieso en el que conviertes el entorno en un arma, creando trampas ingeniosas y caóticas para burlar a los enemigos de formas tan hilarantes como ligeramente maliciosas.
3024120.shortDescriptionEn: Eletta is a mischievous action-adventure where you turn the environment into a weapon, setting up clever and chaotic traps to outwit enemies in ways that are equal parts hilarious and slightly devious.

3046540.shortDescription: ¡Crea minimúsica con otras personas por internet! Un juego creativo y relajado con cocreación asíncrona. Compón canciones únicas con instrumentos disparatados, o simplemente pasa el rato viendo cómo los grupos de otros jugadores se suben al escenario.
3046540.shortDescriptionEn: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

3218570.shortDescription: Falta un mes para el Festival Tanuki y el santuario está en mal estado. Sigue a Pon, el tanuki bonachón y perezoso que trabaja a media jornada en correos y ayúdalo a rehabilitarlo antes de que acabe el verano. ¡Entrega paquetes, haz amistades y acondiciona el santuario para el gran festival!
3218570.shortDescriptionEn: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

3220460.shortDescription: ¡Dirige una acogedora tienda de regalos donde cada cucharada cuenta! Recoge gemas de colores, completa los pedidos de tus clientes, resuelve satisfactorios rompecabezas de embalaje en 3D, mejora tu tienda y convierte tu pequeño negocio en algo especial.
3220460.shortDescriptionEn: Run a cozy gift shop where every scoop counts! Collect colorful gems, fulfill customer orders, solve satisfying 3D packing puzzles, upgrade your shop, and turn your little business into something special.

3224600.shortDescription: Am I Nima es un juego de terror psicológico en el que tendrás que convencer a tu madre de que eres su hija de verdad. Junta palabras en tu cerebro para expresarlas y lograr que ella confíe en ti.
3224600.shortDescriptionEn: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

3273260.shortDescription: ¿Puede un coche de juguete convertirse en el héroe de un videojuego? Una noche, su dueño desapareció misteriosamente sin dejar rastro. Sola en la habitación silenciosa, este pequeño coche emprende un viaje tenebroso y conmovedor para encontrar al niño…
3273260.shortDescriptionEn: Can a toy car become the hero of a video game? One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace. Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

3299080.shortDescription: Empieza solo con una taquilla en la montaña. Retira nieve, corta leña, rompe el hielo de los tejados, todo a mano, todo en primera persona. Sirve bebidas, cocina, repara equipos de esquí y transforma un refugio abandonado en un complejo con hotel, restaurante, bar y tienda.
3299080.shortDescriptionEn: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.

3309160.shortDescription: ¡Construye una civilización única en un mundo plano! Explora, extrae recursos, expándete y combate enemigos. Usa tus habilidades de gestión del tiempo para defenderte de los ataques y acaba con una amenaza misteriosa. ¿Podrás crear un mundo capaz de sobrevivir?
3309160.shortDescriptionEn: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

3318210.shortDescription: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.
3318210.shortDescriptionEn: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

3325390.shortDescription: Planta cara a tus miedos de la infancia en este roguelike de dados con alma noventera. Una tirada de dado y toda tu build se dispara. Encadena combos rotísimos, lucha contra el brócoli y decora tu cuarto con reliquias nostálgicas.
3325390.shortDescriptionEn: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

3339970.shortDescription: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
3339970.shortDescriptionEn: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

3376860.shortDescription: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.
3376860.shortDescriptionEn: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

3412560.shortDescription: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.
3412560.shortDescriptionEn: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.

3479310.shortDescription: Un exigente juego de plataformas 2D dibujado a mano. Domina la técnica del pogo y sube hasta la cima de la torre, donde su creadora espera.
3479310.shortDescriptionEn: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

3492120.shortDescription: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.
3492120.shortDescriptionEn: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

3498700.shortDescription: Un intenso «roguelite» de disparos cenital con mecánicas de «pinball». Domina tu arma, usa el retroceso para controlar la bola y protege a la nave nodriza de los robots invasores. ¡Mejora tu equipo y tus habilidades para ganar la guerra!
3498700.shortDescriptionEn: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

3509380.shortDescription: GrimKeep es un roguelite de composición de dados inspirado en un cuento de hadas de pesadilla. Encuentra objetos, tira los dados y optimiza tu build para desatar un daño brutal. Ábrete paso entre los horrores de la ciudad maldita hasta llegar a la Princesa. Y luego acaba con ella.
3509380.shortDescriptionEn: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

3536530.shortDescription: Embark on a magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.
3536530.shortDescriptionEn: Embark on a magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.

3582690.shortDescription: Un juego de terror cooperativo en el que tú y hasta 5 amigos limpiáis, reparáis y sobrevivís en un centro comercial lo-fi con problemas de alta fidelidad. Bienvenido a la Night Crew: ¡NO te pagan lo suficiente por esto!
3582690.shortDescriptionEn: A co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends clean, fix and survive, in a lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Welcome to the Night Crew - you are NOT paid enough for this!

3591900.shortDescription: Chivalware es un frenético «roguelite» de acción y emparejar casillas. Pon a prueba tu coordinación y reflejos en tiempo real en un campo de batalla cuadriculado: esquiva ataques, empareja casillas para cargar las armas y ataca en el momento más oportuno.
3591900.shortDescriptionEn: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

3596560.shortDescription: Stack & Brew es un juego de gestión en el que preparas pociones y diriges tu propia tienda. Fabrica las pociones y objetos mágicos que pidan tus clientes, entrégalos a tiempo, gana dinero, sube de nivel, amplía tu negocio y enfréntate a jefes.
3596560.shortDescriptionEn: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

3645540.shortDescription: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.
3645540.shortDescriptionEn: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

3669620.shortDescription: Conviértete en la viva imagen de un bullet hell en Warhammer Survivors, un roguelite de supervivencia frenético. Juega como personajes de Warhammer 40,000 y Warhammer: Age of Sigmar, reúne y evoluciona armas icónicas, y destruye oleadas interminables de enemigos.
3669620.shortDescriptionEn: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

3687090.shortDescription: Dice Hoarder es un acogedor juego de organización en el que reabasteces una misteriosa tienda de dados. Ordena todos los dados de la tienda, combínalos para completar sets de siete dados de rol y descubre qué se esconde detrás de tu nuevo trabajo.
3687090.shortDescriptionEn: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

3699850.shortDescription: Has perdido tu alma en una partida de póker con el Diablo. Ahora, en las profundidades del Infierno, solo te queda luchar por recuperar la libertad. Te enfrentarás a una gran variedad de enemigos monstruosos en duelos de póker casi imposibles. Por suerte, haces trampas.
3699850.shortDescriptionEn: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

3721530.shortDescription: Compra motos oxidadas, restaura cada pieza, añade pintura y pegatinas personalizadas, y luego sácalas a probar y véndelas con beneficio. Convierte trastos olvidados en superbikes y haz de tu pequeño garaje el mejor concesionario de la ciudad.
3721530.shortDescriptionEn: Buy rusty motorcycles, restore every part, add custom paint and decals, then take them for a test ride and sell them for a profit. Turn barn finds into superbikes and grow your small garage into the best dealership in town.

3737610.shortDescription: Después de descender a un inframundo roto, debes aprender a atravesar la Colina de Satán. Salta con cohetes usando bolas de fuego explosivas, desbloquea habilidades y domina un sistema de movimiento en constante expansión. Explora los rincones no lineales del inframundo y recupera el Ojo del Mal.
3737610.shortDescriptionEn: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

3739580.shortDescription: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...
3739580.shortDescriptionEn: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

3788110.shortDescription: Un juego de fiesta de fantasía para hasta 8 jugadores, en el que todos participan desde su móvil. ¡Escribe lo que quieres hacer, vota la mejor idea y tira los dados para ver si sale bien!
3788110.shortDescriptionEn: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

3810240.shortDescription: Alimenta y cría a tu pequeño monstruo. Obsérvalo crecer y devorar absolutamente todo lo que encuentra. In Full Bloom es un juego al estilo Katamari con mecánicas inspiradas en el Tamagotchi, protagonizado por una criatura con un hambre insaciable por el mundo que la rodea. Solo hay un camino.
3810240.shortDescriptionEn: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

3839890.shortDescription: ¡Roba cartas, acumula poder y ataca con todo! Un encantador roguelike casual protagonizado por animales magos. Combina cartas de Agua, Fuego y Rayo, consigue más de 150 reliquias y salva un mundo corrompido mientras construyes tu mazo ideal y desarrollas tu propio estilo de juego.
3839890.shortDescriptionEn: Draw it, Store it, Strike hard! A charming casual deckbuilding roguelike with magical animal wizards! Strategically combine elemental cards—Water, Fire, and Lightning—and collect over 150 unique relics to build your deck, customize your playstyle, and save a world tainted by elemental corruption.

3842100.shortDescription: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...
3842100.shortDescriptionEn: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

3861740.shortDescription: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.
3861740.shortDescriptionEn: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

3901850.shortDescription: Tu escritorio se merece un pato. Vive en tu pantalla, se posa en tus ventanas y reacciona a ti. Consigue sombreros en compañía y luego intercámbialos, véndelos o presume de ellos.
3901850.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

3917850.shortDescription: ¡Un simulador de árbitro realista! Saca tarjetas, usa el VAR, dirige partidos y asciende en tu carrera arbitral.
3917850.shortDescriptionEn: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

3934180.shortDescription: Don Memo es un valiente toro que emprende un último viaje a través de Costa Rica para rescatar a su nieta y enfrentar al Pisuicas. Lucha contra leyendas y sombras del pasado en este pixel platformer 2D, mientras cargas con el legado de una familia destinada a proteger al mundo del mal.
3934180.shortDescriptionEn: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

3957770.shortDescription: Un juego de cocina cooperativo donde los pequeños errores desatan el caos rápidamente. Ve de compras, cocina en tu food truck y conduce por la ciudad para entregar los pedidos a tiempo.
3957770.shortDescriptionEn: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

3991790.shortDescription: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!
3991790.shortDescriptionEn: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!

4051290.shortDescription: Tape Man es un juego de plataformas y puzles lleno de mecanismos ocultos. Lanza tu cinta métrica y explora un enorme laberinto hecho de puzles. Tu cinta es a la vez tu plataforma y tu obstáculo. Y puede hacer mucho más — solo tienes que descubrirlo.
4051290.shortDescriptionEn: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

4085920.shortDescription: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.
4085920.shortDescriptionEn: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.

4088360.shortDescription: Entre las cenizas de un pueblo abandonado y desentierra 400 años de maldición, encontrarás una historia de amor, traición y revolución. Sé testigo del pasado con tus propios ojos, descubre una red de secretos y revela la siniestra verdad de lo que duerme bajo los escombros.
4088360.shortDescriptionEn: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

4102120.shortDescription: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.
4102120.shortDescriptionEn: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

4110770.shortDescription: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.
4110770.shortDescriptionEn: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

4139890.shortDescription: Ponte en la piel de un gnomo y explora un bosque vivo en esta aventura de supervivencia PVE y multijugador inspirada en el folclore nórdico. Recolecta recursos, fabrica y construye un hogar para tu familia de gnomos en los árboles y conoce a los Väsen. Juega en solitario o con hasta 8 jugadores.
4139890.shortDescriptionEn: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

4146650.shortDescription: Coge tu teclado y déjate llevar por el ritmo en MUPO. Este trepidante juego de ritmo combina destreza, creatividad y comunidad. Crea mapas, escala posiciones en las tablas de clasificación y define el futuro del juego. Y hay mucho más por venir: ¡no te lo pierdas! ¡Únete a la aventura MUPO!
4146650.shortDescriptionEn: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

4150720.shortDescription: Juega a una ruleta rusa de chupitos con una diablilla que siente por ti un amor de los que matan. Se trata de un juego de supervivencia donde o provocas que ella vomite su alma o será la tuya la que potes. Cuanto más bebas, más reglas podrás saltarte... te lo pasarás de muerte.
4150720.shortDescriptionEn: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

4188070.shortDescription: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!
4188070.shortDescriptionEn: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!

4207990.shortDescription: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.
4207990.shortDescriptionEn: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

4210250.shortDescription: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.
4210250.shortDescriptionEn: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

4225280.shortDescription: Hiciste un pacto con un homúnculo y la cosa ha salido muy mal. Corpus et Spiritus es un juego de creación de mazos tipo «roguelite» sobre la alquimia. Crea cartas, transmuta metales, descubre talismanes mágicos y, sobre todo, ¡sé más sagaz que tu compañero para que no te mate!
4225280.shortDescriptionEn: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

4244180.shortDescription: Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.
4244180.shortDescriptionEn: Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.

4253570.shortDescription: Restaura antigüedades limpiando las capas de polvo, óxido y el paso del tiempo. Reshine es una experiencia minimalista y relajante. Usa herramientas para ver cómo años de suciedad desaparecen ante tus ojos. Sin complicaciones, sin presión, solo la satisfacción de devolver vida a tesoros vintage.
4253570.shortDescriptionEn: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

4255640.shortDescription: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.
4255640.shortDescriptionEn: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

4255780.shortDescription: Un crudo shooter en primera persona de estilo Bodycam donde un golpe de Estado fallido sume la ciudad en el caos. Ábrete paso por calles controladas por bandas, descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de tu esposa y recupera lo que te arrebataron, bala a bala.
4255780.shortDescriptionEn: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

4264410.shortDescription: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!
4264410.shortDescriptionEn: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

4268590.shortDescription: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.
4268590.shortDescriptionEn: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

4297050.shortDescription: ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué siente tu aspiradora robótica cuando deambula por tu casa? Recogiendo tus desórdenes, dejando tus suelos impolutos de nuevo. ¡No te preguntes más! Experimenta las alegrías de limpiar varias casas a través de los LIDARs de varias aspiradoras robóticas sentenciosas.
4297050.shortDescriptionEn: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

4301730.shortDescription: Estás ciego y atrapado en un pasillo infinito de un hospital. Usa tu bastón y otros sentidos para detectar anomalías, cuestionar ilusiones y encontrar una salida.
4301730.shortDescriptionEn: You are blind and trapped in an infinite hospital corridor. Use your guide cane and other senses to detect anomalies, question illusions, and find a way out.

4302300.shortDescription: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.
4302300.shortDescriptionEn: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

4304060.shortDescription: ¡La última entrega de la saga de acción y puzles cooperativos «PICO PARK» llega junto a «Sonic the Hedgehog» de SEGA, en una colaboración alucinante! ¡Montones de partidas cooperativas en las que destaca lo mejor de «Sonic» y de «PICO PARK»! ¡De 2 a 8 jugadores en modo local y online!
4304060.shortDescriptionEn: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

4304900.shortDescription: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!
4304900.shortDescriptionEn: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

4314170.shortDescription: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
4314170.shortDescriptionEn: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.

4321920.shortDescription: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.
4321920.shortDescriptionEn: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

4338800.shortDescription: 🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS、逆天改命的Idle RPG。闯关升级、打BOSS爆神装、结婚生子、组队讨伐、PVP竞技……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！
4338800.shortDescriptionEn: 🎮 一款以修真世界为故事背景，挂机刷BOSS、逆天改命的Idle RPG。闯关升级、打BOSS爆神装、结婚生子、组队讨伐、PVP竞技……内容多到玩不过来，却只需挂机操作！

4351380.shortDescription: ¡Crea tu salón de depilación definitivo! Simula un salón exclusivo para hombres: usa láser médico de última generación para eliminar su vello, opera al límite del dolor, vende paquetes caros, mejora equipos, contrata personal y conviértelo en un santuario masculino.
4351380.shortDescriptionEn: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.

4370210.shortDescription: Tu amigo y tú están atrapados en el mismo cuerpo. En esta aventura cooperativa, aprende a controlar el mismo personaje, aventúrate en el plano espiritual y revela la conspiración de la megaestructura Samsara. ¡La comunicación es la clave!
4370210.shortDescriptionEn: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

4386400.shortDescription: ¡Un emocionante y adorable plataformas lleno de parkour, puzles, momentos de acción y batallas contra jefes te espera! Recoge estrellas, desbloquea nuevas habilidades, descubre secretos, derrota a tus enemigos y supera cada desafío!
4386400.shortDescriptionEn: An exciting and incredibly cute platformer full of parkour, puzzles, action-packed moments, and boss battles awaits you! Collect stars, unlock new abilities, discover secrets, defeat your enemies, and overcome every challenge!

4390080.shortDescription: ¡Únete a una familia de osos y administra el apiario más dulce del mundo! Colecciona y descubre abejas únicas, llena frascos de miel, expande tu granja y mira cómo florece tu campo en este acogedor juego idle de gestión.
4390080.shortDescriptionEn: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

4397220.shortDescription: Un acogedor rancho de caballos que vive en tu escritorio mientras trabajas, o en pantalla completa cuando no. Cría caballos únicos, haz que galopen juntos, compite por monedas, contrata ayudantes y haz crecer tu rancho.
4397220.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Breed one-of-a-kind horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

4414620.shortDescription: Construye dioramas en miniatura, pieza a pieza. Coloca muebles, decoraciones y pequeños detalles hasta completar cada rincón. Relájate, disfruta de ver cada pieza encajar y descubre la historia que esconde cada Book Nook.
4414620.shortDescriptionEn: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

4443690.shortDescription: Cornerwitch es un juego idle acogedor que ocupa una esquina de tu pantalla. Estudia nuevos hechizos y emprende un viaje mágico. Desbloquea objetos cosméticos para vestir a tu pequeña bruja, sube de nivel y hazte más fuerte.
4443690.shortDescriptionEn: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

4450600.shortDescription: Explora el maravilloso mundo del crack por tu cuenta o con hasta 50 jugadores. Traiciona a tus amigos o coopera con ellos para ganar dinero y construir tu imperio. Roba, mata y ábrete camino hasta la cima mientras sigues colocado.
4450600.shortDescriptionEn: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.

4463520.shortDescription: Acompaña a los Mumin en una aventura point-and-click preciosa y acogedora inspirada en la entrañable novela de Tove Jansson. Esta vez, Mumintrol, la Pequeña My y sus amigos necesitan tu ayuda para escapar de una gran inundación y encontrar la forma de regresar a su hogar: el Valle de los Mumin.
4463520.shortDescriptionEn: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

4469080.shortDescription: Disfrázate de diablillos y ayúdales a cumplir su sueño: viajar al Oeste, conseguir las escrituras sagradas y convertirse en Buda. Un RPG de grupo relajado, con arte dibujado a mano y combate automático para luchar, mejorar y superar pruebas con unos monstruitos muy graciosos.
4469080.shortDescriptionEn: Disguise yourself as little demons on a pilgrimage West to become Buddha! A cozy, hand-drawn party-based RPG with auto-battle, so you can easily fight, upgrade, and clear trials with a cast of funny misfit monsters.

4481330.shortDescription: Un juego incremental en el que excavas tumbas malditas, recolectas huesos, carne y diversos recursos, y ensamblas tu propia criatura desde cero. Descubre poderosos artefactos, experimenta con combinaciones únicas y da vida a tu creación, pieza a pieza.
4481330.shortDescriptionEn: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.

4493130.shortDescription: Crea tu imperio en la nieve: construye la acogedora estación de esquí de tus sueños en este juego de gestión. Adáptate al clima cambiante, traza pistas, coloca telesillas y construye alojamientos y bares de après-ski que mantendrán a miles de visitantes felices, calentitos y con la barriga llena.
4493130.shortDescriptionEn: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

4504940.shortDescription: Explora el Antiguo Egipto en busca de sus tesoros perdidos. Un relajante juego de buscar diferencias con estilo low poly 3D ambientado en preciosos escenarios hechos a mano.
4504940.shortDescriptionEn: Explore Ancient Egypt in search of its lost treasures. A relaxing low poly 3D spot-the-difference game set across beautiful, hand-crafted scenes.

4516210.shortDescription: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.
4516210.shortDescriptionEn: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

4521650.shortDescription: Cultiva ingredientes frescos y lleva tu propio pequeño restaurante. Disfruta de un día tranquilo que va del campo a la mesa. Planifica un menú fresco para un día estupendo, mantén tu despensa bien surtida y haz felices a tus clientes. Gana tu propio dinero y construye tu pequeño mundo paso a paso.
4521650.shortDescriptionEn: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

4526450.shortDescription: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.
4526450.shortDescriptionEn: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.

4528040.shortDescription: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
4528040.shortDescriptionEn: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

4534960.shortDescription: Juega en cooperativo como la tripulación de la peor aerolínea del mundo. Tu avión se cae a pedazos, tu carga es ilegal, y la seguridad de los pasajeros apenas entra en la lista de prioridades.
4534960.shortDescriptionEn: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

4537400.shortDescription: Turn any PDF, TXT or DOCX into an interactive visual novel. Pick an anime companion, upload a paper or any text you want to understand, and let AI turn it into a 5–10 minute story — with quizzes, voice narration, a blackboard for formulas, and full character customization via Steam Workshop.
4537400.shortDescriptionEn: Turn any PDF, TXT or DOCX into an interactive visual novel. Pick an anime companion, upload a paper or any text you want to understand, and let AI turn it into a 5–10 minute story — with quizzes, voice narration, a blackboard for formulas, and full character customization via Steam Workshop.

4555040.shortDescription: Sushiamo es un roguelike de construcción de mazos donde haces sushi para alcanzar puntuaciones absurdas. ¡Descubre ingredientes únicos, salsas, herramientas que cambian el juego y navega por el mapa para romper el juego con combos de locura!
4555040.shortDescriptionEn: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

4559930.shortDescription: Construye y gestiona un mercado espiritual inspirado en Japón, da la bienvenida a espíritus errantes, produce y vende recursos y haz crecer tu espacio entre recuerdos y una atmósfera acogedora.
4559930.shortDescriptionEn: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

4574820.shortDescription: Eres un garabato defectuoso arrojado a la basura. Lucha contra bocetos rivales, absorbe sus poderes y cábrate camino hacia la venganza. Mira cómo los números suben sin parar en este idle battler de segundo monitor. Cada partida es única gracias a su enorme árbol de habilidades.
4574820.shortDescriptionEn: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

4593350.shortDescription: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.
4593350.shortDescriptionEn: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.

4593380.shortDescription: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
4593380.shortDescriptionEn: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).

4599880.shortDescription: Una sim acogedora de gestión inmobiliaria donde restauras el edificio ruinoso que te dejó tu abuela. Encuentra inquilinos, cobra alquileres, mejóralo. Pero no se te ocurra poner a un elfo que hace solos de guitarra a medianoche al lado de un yeti filósofo. Pedidos sin fin y dulce caos te esperan.
4599880.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

4602120.shortDescription: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
4602120.shortDescriptionEn: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

4633120.shortDescription: Un juego de carreras psicodélico donde no hay sitio para los límites ni los frenos. Compite en carreras de 30 segundos sobre un cilindro cósmico que no deja de girar y donde la muerte acecha en cada curva. Persigue récords mundiales, derrota a los fantasmas de otros pilotos y tráete hasta 7 amigos.
4633120.shortDescriptionEn: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

4634570.shortDescription: Tu escritorio es su mando. Cada clic, cada pulsación de tecla y cada movimiento del ratón lo ayudan a crecer. Widget Idle vive tranquilamente en un rincón de tu escritorio mientras tú te dedicas a las cosas más importantes de la vida. Ahora con una pizca más de felicidad :)
4634570.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)

4642320.shortDescription: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!
4642320.shortDescriptionEn: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

4644170.shortDescription: ¡AIM × Gestión de tienda! Recolecta, procesa, fabrica y atiende a clientes, todo con tu puntería. ¡Si dejas escapar a un cliente, es Game Over! Domina el flick & tracking aim y sobrevive al caos. ¡Multijugador online!
4644170.shortDescriptionEn: A hyper-fast shopkeeping game where every task is performed with your aim! Keep performing at your best by thinking carefully about efficiency and task order. Three difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned experts! Online co-op and versus multiplayer supported.

4652930.shortDescription: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.
4652930.shortDescriptionEn: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

4661070.shortDescription: HANDS OVER es un juego de terror cooperativo para 5 jugadores donde pruebas inocentes se vuelven crueles desafíos de suerte y nervios. Farolea, sabotea a tus amigos, juega sucio y aguanta en la mesa más que nadie.
4661070.shortDescriptionEn: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

4672030.shortDescription: Un simulador de colonias en el que juegas como la mazmorra: su Amo, sus esbirros y las bestias de sus cuevas. Excava salas, monta y conecta trampas mortales y saquea tesoros en la superficie. Luego defiéndelos de los héroes que vienen a recuperarlos. Juega solo o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo.
4672030.shortDescriptionEn: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

4672980.shortDescription: Bienvenido a CoreMine Corp. Como empleado, debe establecer cadenas de producción, gestionar su electricidad, hacer malabarismos entre contratos y stock mientras mejora su fábrica. Demuestre su valía.
4672980.shortDescriptionEn: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

4704000.shortDescription: Shark Mart es un simulador cooperativo loco sobre tiburones infiltrados disfrazados de delfines amigables. Gestiona la tienda, limpia ballenas y secuestra peces desprevenidos para cocinar deliciosos platos. ¡Pero cuidado! La Policía de los Peces quiere descubrir vuestro secreto dentado...
4704000.shortDescriptionEn: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

4707700.shortDescription: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition es la versión definitiva del juego e incluye todas las expansiones publicadas anteriormente, además de nuevo contenido, mejoras de jugabilidad y visuales, y numerosas mejoras de calidad de vida para ofrecer la experiencia de minería de oro más completa.
4707700.shortDescriptionEn: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

4714010.shortDescription: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.
4714010.shortDescriptionEn: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

4714850.shortDescription: Sheepscape es un acogedor simulador de granja centrado en las ovejas. Manda a tu perro a reunir el rebaño, esquila por tu cuenta en un minijuego, vende la lana y cría un rebaño mejor estación tras estación. Todo el oficio del pastor, desde tu primer prado embarrado hasta las vastas Highlands.
4714850.shortDescriptionEn: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

4729050.shortDescription: Un relajante juego idle de trenes. Construye tu propio tren en la parte inferior de la pantalla, comercia, transporta pasajeros y cultiva mientras disfrutas de un tranquilo viaje por un hermoso mundo de pixel art.
4729050.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

4767430.shortDescription: Se acerca el verano y consigues un trabajo de fotógrafo en el campus. Te acompañan Liu Shilin, cariñosa; Li Feier, fría pero cálida por dentro; Xia Wei, modelo traviesa; y Le Tong, amiga de la infancia. Juntos preparan las fotos de graduación. Con ellas empieza tu verano de emociones…
4767430.shortDescriptionEn: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

4773720.shortDescription: A 30 minute photographed social disaster. And you're invited!
4773720.shortDescriptionEn: A 30 minute photographed social disaster. And you're invited!

4778330.shortDescription: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
4778330.shortDescriptionEn: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

4780870.shortDescription: ¡Trabaja, navega o juega a otros juegos mientras los huevos eclosionan en segundo plano! Colecciona más de 300 mascotas, desbloquea potentes mejoras y forma tu equipo de combate.
4780870.shortDescriptionEn: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

4784510.shortDescription: Vive los últimos días del viejo Petro en una pequeña aldea hacia la que se aproxima un gigantesco leviatán. Un juego de terror existencial sobre lo inevitable, la soledad y un hombre que no tiene adónde ir ni ningún motivo para marcharse.
4784510.shortDescriptionEn: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

4786650.shortDescription: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.
4786650.shortDescriptionEn: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.

4802530.shortDescription: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!
4802530.shortDescriptionEn: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

4811080.shortDescription: Un juego de terror psicológico minimalista inspirado en The Exit 8, en el que los jugadores deben escapar de un pasillo de hospital abandonado de la era postsoviética, que se repite en bucle, detectando anomalías.
4811080.shortDescriptionEn: A psychological horror game inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of P.T. and the anomaly-detection gameplay of The Exit 8, where players must detect anomalies to escape a looping abandoned hospital.

4832970.shortDescription: What the Buck?! es un juego incremental muy satisfactorio sobre destruir dinero. Tritura fajos de billetes, provoca reacciones en cadena por toda la mesa, haz prestigio para conseguir mejoras permanentes y automatiza tu destrucción de dinero. Tu progreso de la demo pasa al juego completo.
4832970.shortDescriptionEn: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

4852570.shortDescription: Un incremental acogedor con un pixel art precioso y una bandada de palomas monísimas. Apunta a un parque lleno de gente, trae las monedas a casa y gástalas en mejoras. Cada paloma tiene su propio superpoder. Vuela, recoge, mejora.
4852570.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy incremental with beautiful pixel art and a flock of adorable pigeons. Aim at a busy park, bring the coins home and spend them on upgrades. Every pigeon gets its own superpower. Swoop, collect, upgrade.

4860910.shortDescription: La prisión nunca duerme. Conspira, comercia, roba y construye tu reputación en un MMORPG social donde cada preso puede convertirse en tu mejor aliado... o en tu peor enemigo. Elige tu delito entre 12 clases únicas, forma clanes y colecciona las chapas de tus rivales. ¿Y tú por qué entrarás?
4860910.shortDescriptionEn: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

4863540.shortDescription: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!
4863540.shortDescriptionEn: A satisfying incremental idle game that drops the pretense to give you pure unadulterated progress. Boost, earn bonuses and buy upgrades to speed up your progress or take it easy and let it make progress by itself while you make progress elsewhere. No stress, only progress!

4873800.shortDescription: Resuelve puzles giratorios con adorables chicas gato. Una experiencia acogedora con progresión incremental suave. Charla con chicas gato. Mejora en los puzles de alguna manera. Toma decisiones cuestionables. Desbloquea cosas sorprendentemente útiles.
4873800.shortDescriptionEn: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.

4877420.shortDescription: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.
4877420.shortDescriptionEn: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

4880410.shortDescription: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.
4880410.shortDescriptionEn: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

4891550.shortDescription: Escapa de la mansión antes de que te reclame. Un cooperativo de terror para 1–5 jugadores.
4891550.shortDescriptionEn: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

4901860.shortDescription: Un incremental arcade en el que tú eres el tornado. Arrasa campos, coches y edificios, cobra por los destrozos y gástatelo en mejoras entre partidas. Conviértete en fuego, inundación, hielo o vacío. Haz pedazos la Tierra, llévate tu tormenta a un mundo alienígena y cría vacas en una granja propia.
4901860.shortDescriptionEn: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.

4912740.shortDescription: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.
4912740.shortDescriptionEn: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

4921660.shortDescription: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!
4921660.shortDescriptionEn: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!

4932310.shortDescription: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.
4932310.shortDescriptionEn: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.

4933500.shortDescription: Me and You es un juego de puzles cooperativo inspirado en el aclamado “Baba Is You”. Crea, cambia y rompe las reglas de cada nivel para resolverlo juntos.
4933500.shortDescriptionEn: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

4940900.shortDescription: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.
4940900.shortDescriptionEn: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

4946440.shortDescription: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.
4946440.shortDescriptionEn: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

4948940.shortDescription: Swarmbreaker es un juego de defensa de torres incremental en el que debes defender tu base de una gigantesca ola viviente de insectos alienígenas. ¡Construye defensas para bloquear su camino, despliega armamento pesado, mejora tu arsenal y aplasta al enjambre!
4948940.shortDescriptionEn: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

4960570.shortDescription: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?
4960570.shortDescriptionEn: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

4966990.shortDescription: Un roguelite de construcción de mazos por turnos en pixel art: tus cartas son espadas, hachas y lanzas, y las lanzas. Las armas se quedan en el tablero: golpea una con otra para activar la Resonancia, que se encadena a las armas cercanas. La síntesis transfiere habilidades.
4966990.shortDescriptionEn: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

4972050.shortDescription: Resettle es un juego incremental de construcción de ciudades con gran profundidad en el que desarrollas asentamientos en islas. Coloca edificios estratégicamente para maximizar la producción de recursos, explora 10 sistemas de mejoras diferentes y crea una próspera ciudad isleña.
4972050.shortDescriptionEn: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

4986050.shortDescription: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!
4986050.shortDescriptionEn: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!
