4990840.shortDescription: ¡Modela, pinta e intégrate en el entorno! FAKE ME es un juego del escondite multijugador donde creas tu camuflaje. Con herramientas 3D sencillas, diseña el objeto que imitarás. Modela también tu disfraz. ¡Escóndete de los Seekers o encuentra a todos los Fakers a tiempo!
4990840.shortDescriptionEn: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

4990940.shortDescription: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.
4990940.shortDescriptionEn: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

4997480.shortDescription: ¡Dibuja mapas, haz que las naciones se enfrenten y crea timelapses históricos o de fantasía con Mapping Creator: una herramienta para dar rienda suelta a tu creatividad!
4997480.shortDescriptionEn: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

5000170.shortDescription: Un juego de terror y supervivencia para 1–4 jugadores. Maneja una perforadora gigante. Explora cuevas, recoge objetos valiosos y huye de las criaturas. Vuelve a la superficie para vender y comprar mejoras y equipo. Juega en solitario o en cooperativo online.
5000170.shortDescriptionEn: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

5015590.shortDescription: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?
5015590.shortDescriptionEn: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?

5017810.shortDescription: El tesoro del dragón se ha descontrolado. Ponte cómodo, recoge montañas de oro moneda a moneda, llena cofre tras cofre y devuelve cada tesoro enterrado a su lugar en las estanterías. Mira cómo el caos se convierte en orden, pieza a pieza. Un juego cozy de ordenar. Hay gatos.
5017810.shortDescriptionEn: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

5019170.shortDescription: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.
5019170.shortDescriptionEn: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

5036870.shortDescription: Terror psicológico en la admisión nocturna de un depósito. Cada cuerpo llega con papeles que deben coincidir con él. Pésalo, mídelo, tómale la temperatura, escúchale el pecho. Algunos aún tienen pulso. El reglamento suma una página cada noche, y parte de lo que registras no se queda así.
5036870.shortDescriptionEn: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Every body arrives with paperwork that has to match it. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature, listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

5037200.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
5037200.shortDescriptionEn: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

5049560.shortDescription: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.
5049560.shortDescriptionEn: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.

5051080.shortDescription: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!
5051080.shortDescriptionEn: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

5066010.shortDescription: «Here Comes the Horde» es un juego de combate automático e incremental en el que mandas tropas a defender tu castillo contra hordas de muertos vivientes. Sobrevive a los ataques, desbloquea nuevas unidades, consigue poderosas habilidades e invade la pantalla con tropas por doquier.
5066010.shortDescriptionEn: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.

5072600.shortDescription: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
5072600.shortDescriptionEn: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

5084410.shortDescription: Journey TD es un roguelite de defensa de torres donde tus torres son el laberinto. Elige tus elementos y escoge entre 168 torres. Combina potenciadores, equipo, runas y tres árboles de talentos en builds letales. Cada semana, reta a otros jugadores con el mismo seed por liderar la clasificación.
5084410.shortDescriptionEn: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.

5086460.shortDescription: Un caótico juego de fiesta multijugador en el que bebes, llenas tu vejiga y compites con tus amigos para mear en la mayor cantidad de sitios posible. ¡Bebe, apunta bien y reclama el mayor territorio para ganar!
5086460.shortDescriptionEn: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

5087750.shortDescription: «Maiden Party» – ¡un RPG de cartas tipo *idle* con estética anime! Colecciona cientos de chicas en formato Live2D, crea tus propios mazos para librar batallas estratégicas y obtén recursos incluso cuando no estés jugando.
5087750.shortDescriptionEn: Maiden Party, an anime waifu idle card RPG. Collect hundreds of Live2D maidens, build decks for tactical battles and gain rewards offline. Explore fantasy dungeons, farm & fish in your homestead, raid world bosses with guildmates and unlock character bonds.

5088960.shortDescription: Enséñale la escuela a Yu en una breve novela visual de terror psicológico con una historia inconexa como un sueño. Un juego retro experimental creado para un solo disquete de 3,5 pulgadas, ahora en Steam.
5088960.shortDescriptionEn: Let's show〈Yuu〉, the new student, around school. A short psycho-horror visual novel depicting a mysterious relationship with her, unfolding without context like a dream. The Steam version of an experimental retro game designed to fit on a single 3.5-inch floppy disk.

5110520.shortDescription: 2040. Despiertas en una ciudad invadida por otro mundo. Puedes excavar el terreno sin límites. Apilando bloques puedes construir casas, castillos y fortalezas. Las chicas monstruo que encuentres en las tierras salvajes se convertirán en tus compañeras si las capturas. Lucharán y vivirán a tu lado para sostener tu reino.
5110520.shortDescriptionEn: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

5111890.shortDescription: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.
5111890.shortDescriptionEn: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

5111930.shortDescription: ¡No dejes que tu colega te mate! :)) Rally cooperativo caótico con hasta 8 jugadores en 4 coches. Esquiva animales, limpia el barro y confía en tu copiloto. Pinta tu coche, abróchate el cinturón e intentad que vuestra amistad llegue a la meta.
5111930.shortDescriptionEn: Don't let your buddy kill you! :)) 2-player co-op panic asymmetrical game. Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.

5111980.shortDescription: Yuki lleva una vida corriente, cargando con sus deudas, unos pocos amigos y poemas que no comparte con nadie. Hasta que llega alguien más a clase. Porque hay presencias a las que no te puedes resistir. Solo puedes rendirte.
5111980.shortDescriptionEn: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.

5127260.shortDescription: Juego isométrico de ciudad medieval. Convierte un señorío de pocas chozas en villa de mercado. Una casa mejora si su familia tiene comida, agua y los servicios que necesita. Haz acopio antes del invierno, cuando nada crece. Luego llegan asaltantes a quemar la villa: levanta torres para frenarlos.
5127260.shortDescriptionEn: An isometric medieval city builder. Grow one manor from a few hovels into a market town. Houses upgrade when the families in them get the food, water and services they need. Stock up before winter, when nothing grows. Later, raiders come to set the town on fire, and you build towers to stop them.

5133900.shortDescription: Un satisfactorio juego incremental en primera persona sobre convertir criaturas adorables en latas. Mátalas, recoge sus cuerpos, enlátalas y véndelas. Gana dinero, mejora tus armas y máquinas, y produce cada vez más.
5133900.shortDescriptionEn: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

5134730.shortDescription: TAKE MY BOMB es un juego de fiesta en línea: pasa la bomba a un amigo a tiempo para sobrevivir. ¡En los últimos 10 segundos, solo quien lleva la bomba ve el contador! ¿Quién sobrevivirá a este duelo de nervios con una bomba imprevisible? Antes de jugar, recuerda algo: “¡Con tal de que no sea yo!”
5134730.shortDescriptionEn: TAKE MY BOMB is an online party game: pass the bomb to a friend in time to survive. In the final 10 seconds, only the bomb holder sees the timer! Who will last to the end in a battle of wits over a bomb that could blow anytime? Before you start, remember one thing: “As long as it’s not me!”

5138990.shortDescription: Drena la vida de todo lo que te rodea en este juego incremental de agricultura a la inversa. Infecta todo lo que crece, mejora tus plagas y marchita el mundo hasta que no quede nada vivo.
5138990.shortDescriptionEn: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

5140150.shortDescription: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.
5140150.shortDescriptionEn: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

5157730.shortDescription: Snow of Penglai is a yuri-themed visual novel set in ancient China. Players will step into the shoes of Xuanhua, a puppet girl, and confront everything about the witch Zhu Hanchuan. This is a story of rebirth. A lotus rising, bleeding, blooming anew.
5157730.shortDescriptionEn: Snow of Penglai is a yuri-themed visual novel set in ancient China. Players will step into the shoes of Xuanhua, a puppet girl, and confront everything about the witch Zhu Hanchuan. This is a story of rebirth. A lotus rising, bleeding, blooming anew.

5164110.shortDescription: Bio Inc. Total Defense es un tower defense incremental ambientado dentro de tu cuerpo. Dirige tu sistema inmunitario contra hordas masivas de virus, bacterias y otros patógenos. Mejora tus defensas, colócalas con astucia y lucha por cada centímetro de tu cuerpo.
5164110.shortDescriptionEn: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

5168960.shortDescription: Un juego de estrategia medieval en el que una corona rival asedia tu ciudad. Dirige a tus tropas en las murallas y en el campo, y entre rondas enciende almenaras para elegir qué aliados acudirán en tu ayuda. Ganes o pierdas, cada batalla te da renombre para fortalecer Aldmark.
5168960.shortDescriptionEn: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

5170520.shortDescription: Forma tu equipo de monstruos, elige contra qué enemigos luchar, recluta a los que derrotes y haz evolucionar a tu equipo en un autobattler roguelite con mejoras permanentes. ¡Adapta tu estrategia y enfréntate a jefes cada vez más poderosos!
5170520.shortDescriptionEn: Build your team of monsters, choose which enemies to fight, recruit the ones you defeat, and evolve your team in a roguelite autobattler with permanent buffs. Adapt your strategy and face increasingly powerful Bosses!

5182840.shortDescription: En Way Too Many Eggs empiezas con una pequeña granja y acabas hasta arriba de huevos. Recógelos, cría gallinas, contrata ayudantes y rompe huevos gigantes. Un juego incremental con mejoras permanentes en el árbol de habilidades para que cada ronda vaya a más.
5182840.shortDescriptionEn: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

5185210.shortDescription: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. Prior to his death, Reverend Lawrence was a devout Christian and an example for the community of Happyhills. Everyone has skeletons in their closets, but some more than others...
5185210.shortDescriptionEn: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. Prior to his death, Reverend Lawrence was a devout Christian and an example for the community of Happyhills. Everyone has skeletons in their closets, but some more than others...

5185750.shortDescription: Un simulador de construcción de ciudades centrado en el tráfico. Construye tu ciudad con herramientas de trazado de carreteras libremente, sin depender de cuadrículas. Resuelve los atascos de tráfico con rotondas, semáforos totalmente personalizables y grandes enlaces de autopistas.
5185750.shortDescriptionEn: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, and sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

5190490.shortDescription: One More Floor es un breve juego incremental. Baja en ascensor a las minas, da en el blanco para multiplicar tus monedas en cada planta y cobra antes de morir. Desbloquea nuevas minas, colecciona gemas raras y compra mejoras de prestigio permanentes.
5190490.shortDescriptionEn: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

5190580.shortDescription: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.
5190580.shortDescriptionEn: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

5196330.shortDescription: Diseña el chip que impulsa la IA. Empieza con una sola puerta lógica y construye un ordenador: conecta circuitos, convierte tus diseños en chips reutilizables, programa pequeños kernels y amplía tu arquitectura hasta crear una GPU funcional.
5196330.shortDescriptionEn: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

5239830.shortDescription: Lucha contra zombis, saquea ciudades, explora la naturaleza, caza, fabrica y construye una base en un mundo nuevo en cada partida. Empieza sin nada y sobrevive con hasta 3 amigos. Cada séptima noche, la Luna de Sangre trae a la horda hasta tus muros.
5239830.shortDescriptionEn: Fight zombies, scavenge cities, explore the wild, hunt, craft and build a base in a world that is new every game. Start with nothing and survive with up to 3 friends. Every seventh night, the Blood Moon brings the horde to your walls.

5249670.shortDescription: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you pair 3,500 wands with their matching cases and file them across a two-storey wand shop. Read each magical stave, restore every pigeon hole, unlock helpful skills, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.
5249670.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you pair 3,500 wands with their matching cases and file them across a two-storey wand shop. Read each magical stave, restore every pigeon hole, unlock helpful skills, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

5256610.shortDescription: Construye un imperio empresarial por todo Estados Unidos. Crea empresas, abre y mejora activos. Expándete por distintos sectores, domina mercados, controla una parte cada vez mayor de la economía y acumula una fortuna de billones de dólares.
5256610.shortDescriptionEn: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

5257930.shortDescription: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!
5257930.shortDescriptionEn: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!

5266240.shortDescription: Un juego de pelar patatas en primera persona. Tienes un cuchillo. Tienes un cubo. Tienes una montaña de patatas. Pélalas con física real. Corta fino, no desperdicies nada. Compra mejores herramientas. Pela hasta que no quede nada. Nadie pela como tú.
5266240.shortDescriptionEn: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

5275590.shortDescription: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players
5275590.shortDescriptionEn: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

5277000.shortDescription: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.
5277000.shortDescriptionEn: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.

5295330.shortDescription: Water TD es un tower defense donde el enemigo es una inundación. Cientos de miles de gotas corren hacia tu base, se amontonan contra tus torretas y se cuelan por cada hueco. Dispárale, quémala, electrocútala o hazla retroceder, y mejora tus defensas en un gran árbol de habilidades entre niveles.
5295330.shortDescriptionEn: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

5296640.shortDescription: Sort Them Fish es un acogedor simulador de organización en el que devuelves 2538 peces a sus acuarios. Llena los tanques, desbloquea habilidades y transforma el caos de una tienda de acuariofilia en una preciosa colección bien ordenada.
5296640.shortDescriptionEn: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

5303440.shortDescription: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out the truth in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.
5303440.shortDescriptionEn: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out the truth in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.

5303520.shortDescription: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.
5303520.shortDescriptionEn: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.

5318580.shortDescription: "Jyoka" es un juego de estrategia y construcción del siglo XVI en Japón. Desarrolla tu territorio con más de 190 instalaciones y otorga arrozales a tus vasallos. Conéctate y defiéndete de bandidos o daimyos. ¡Asedia más de 70 castillos reales y unifica el país!
5318580.shortDescriptionEn: "Jyoka" is a 16th-century Japanese castle town builder. Develop your territory with 190+ facilities and grant rice fields to retainers to secure loyalty. Defend against bandits and daimyos. Once stable, launch epic sieges against 70+ real-inspired castles to unify Japan!

5319020.shortDescription: Un acogedor juego de orden en primera persona ambientado en una tienda de arte llena de objetos raros y bellos. Ordena 2942 materiales de bellas artes y piezas artesanales de decenas de formas, estante a estante, color a color, y desbloquea habilidades.
5319020.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

5325220.shortDescription: Crea un avatar humano o animal que viva en tu escritorio. Vístelo, deja que te acompañe mientras trabajas o escuchas música y envíalo a la pantalla de un amigo con un saludo, un abrazo o un pequeño regalo. Gratis para siempre, para repartir cariño.
5325220.shortDescriptionEn: Create a human or animal avatar that lives on your desktop. Dress them up, let them keep you company while you work or listen to music, use them as a VTube Avatar or send them to a friend’s screen with a wave, a hug or a little gift. Free to play forever to spread the warmth.

5342930.shortDescription: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
5342930.shortDescriptionEn: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.

5345040.shortDescription: ¡Un juego incremental adorable y lleno de dopamina! Basta con pasar el cursor. Clava tenedores en fruta gigante para ganar oro, compra más tenedores y elige bendiciones que formen sinergias. ¡Machaca la fruta, conviértela en mermelada y gástala en habilidades poderosas!
5345040.shortDescriptionEn: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

5347650.shortDescription: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.
5347650.shortDescriptionEn: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.

5354780.shortDescription: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.
5354780.shortDescriptionEn: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

5365570.shortDescription: MATE, This Place is a MESS! es un juego cozy de ordenar 5.000 paquetes de yerba en un museo hecho un caos. Llená los estantes, cebate un mate, desbloqueá habilidades y pateá paquetes a su lugar. Al fondo del salón, un telón enorme esconde la verdad del museo. ¿Cuál será?
5365570.shortDescriptionEn: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

5375410.shortDescription: Link Loop es un juego de plataformas y puzles en 2D basado en portales y una física muy satisfactoria. Usa portales para mover objetos, redirigir láseres y transportar fluidos. Los niveles tienen varias soluciones, y la creatividad es clave.
5375410.shortDescriptionEn: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

5378110.shortDescription: Corta el pasto en primera persona arriba de un tractorcito destartalado, solo o en cooperativo online, hasta 6. Eres un viejo gruñón que fuma, toma cerveza barata y no le importa nada, pero deja franjas perfectas. Una vecina exigente, un campo de golf abandonado, una boda en una isla.
5378110.shortDescriptionEn: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

5390670.shortDescription: "Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver. Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive. Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?
5390670.shortDescriptionEn: "Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver. Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive. Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?

5395920.shortDescription: Pon orden en una tienda repleta de ranas coleccionables. Recoge y clasifica figuras de colores, llena estanterías temáticas, desbloquea mejoras útiles y busca huevos escondidos. Completa tu colección rana a rana.
5395920.shortDescriptionEn: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

5419140.shortDescription: **Ludoman** es un simulador de vida ambientado en una Rusia cubierta de nieve. Paga una hipoteca de 250.000 rublos, trabaja, apuesta tu dinero y explora un mundo abierto. Una sola vida, libertad total y múltiples finales. ¡Tu destino está en tus manos!
5419140.shortDescriptionEn: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!

5420970.shortDescription: ¡Fotografía! ¡Recorta! ¡Pega! Un juego de fiesta online: haz fotos por un colorido mundo 3D, recórtalas y pega los recortes para construir lo que pide la ronda. Después, vota y adivina quién ha hecho cada obra. No hace falta saber dibujar.
5420970.shortDescriptionEn: Snap it. Snip it. Stick it. An online party game: take photos in a colorful 3D world, cut them up and stick the pieces together to make what the round asks for. Then vote and guess who made what. No drawing skills needed.

5427110.shortDescription: Lost Bitcoin es un juego de excavación y automatización en una gigantesca chatarrería. Recoge chatarra, quémala para conseguir monedas, compra mejoras y construye una fábrica que trabaje para ti. Abre cajas y cajas fuertes, y revisa cada memoria USB para encontrar tu monedero de Bitcoin perdido.
5427110.shortDescriptionEn: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

5441620.shortDescription: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.
5441620.shortDescriptionEn: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.

5443350.shortDescription: Chisel Me This es un juego de fiesta para 1-8 jugadores en el que compites con tus amigos creando esculturas a partir de distintos temas. ¡Talla enormes bloques de mármol, moldea arcilla y sabotea a tus rivales mientras creáis auténticas obras de arte!
5443350.shortDescriptionEn: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!

5450430.shortDescription: El yate es un bote roto. El timón, un tapacubos. Los peces, ya ni hablemos.
5450430.shortDescriptionEn: A free fishing game made by one guy who has been making fishing games since 2008. Catch 100+ weird fish for the fridge door, work your way up from an Oak Branch to the Necro-pole, win the weekly derbies, beat real players 1v1, and tune the deck radio: 4 stations, DJs and 160+ original songs.

5451260.shortDescription: Code Market es un juego de gestión tranquilo: no haces clic, escribes Java o C# de verdad. El robot hace justo lo que dice tu código: ir a la estantería, coger tomates, tomar pedidos, llenar bolsas y reponer. De las variables a la herencia, jugando, o automatiza el supermercado entero.
5451260.shortDescriptionEn: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java or C# code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

5457010.shortDescription: 777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko! And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry! The controls are super simple too!
5457010.shortDescriptionEn: 777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko! And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry! The controls are super simple too!

5458210.shortDescription: Un juego cooperativo de construcción online para 1–8 jugadores. Fabricad ladrillos, construid una enorme pirámide y automatizad la producción. Reunid a vuestros amigos, contratad ayudantes y encontrad formas cada vez más disparatadas de llevar los ladrillos hasta arriba.
5458210.shortDescriptionEn: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

5460910.shortDescription: Comedia aérea cooperativa para 1-4 jugadores. Dirige con tus amigos una minúscula aerolínea isleña, mantén en el aire un avión que se cae a trozos, repáralo en pleno vuelo y ten contenta a una cabina llena de pasajeros. O, al menos, con vida.
5460910.shortDescriptionEn: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.

5472080.shortDescription: SHRED A BILLION es un juego incremental en primera persona sobre una montaña de dinero. ¡Coge billetes con las manos, recógelos con un cubo, sube de nivel y échale mil millones de dólares a la trituradora! ¡Solo quedan 3.929.120.202 billetes!
5472080.shortDescriptionEn: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

5472200.shortDescription: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12 aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.
5472200.shortDescriptionEn: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12 aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

5482350.shortDescription: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.
5482350.shortDescriptionEn: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.

5498410.shortDescription: New Capybara, 1933. Private investigator Sam Malone and his assistant, Tommy, take on a case to find a missing wooden leg that contains a secret ledger. A branching noir detective story infused with dark humor, where any choice could be your last.
5498410.shortDescriptionEn: New Capybara, 1933. Private investigator Sam Malone and his assistant, Tommy, take on a case to find a missing wooden leg that contains a secret ledger. A branching noir detective story infused with dark humor, where any choice could be your last.

5508060.shortDescription: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment
5508060.shortDescriptionEn: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment

5513980.shortDescription: Una noche, sin darle mucha importancia, empiezas un directo para enseñar tu habitación a los espectadores. A partir de esa noche, tu tranquila vida cotidiana empieza a desmoronarse...
5513980.shortDescriptionEn: One night, you casually start a livestream to show viewers around your room. From that night on, your peaceful everyday life begins to fall apart...

5521600.shortDescription: Cambia la oficina por un casco de buzo de latón y una granjita en el fondo del mar. Cultiva algas y uvas de mar, cría erizos y atunes, gánate la amistad de la gente del mar de Bahía Coral y despierta un viejo arrecife blanqueado en este acogedor juego de granja, a solas o con un amigo en línea.
5521600.shortDescriptionEn: Trade your office job for a brass diving helmet and a little farm on the sea floor. Grow kelp and sea grapes, raise urchins and tuna, befriend the merfolk of Coral Cove and wake a bleached old reef back to life in this cozy underwater farming game, alone or with a friend in online co-op.

5527800.shortDescription: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.
5527800.shortDescriptionEn: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.

5529210.shortDescription: ¡Pon en orden el taller mecánico! Clasifica las herramientas y las piezas de repuesto, coloca cada cosa en su sitio, limpia la suciedad y monta un coche pieza a pieza.
5529210.shortDescriptionEn: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

5531790.shortDescription: ¡Limpia el oasis! Echa el desierto en tu mochila, convierte la arena en oro y mejora desde un guante de algodón hasta una auténtica tormenta de arena. Descubre un oasis verde, tesoros ocultos y robots ayudantes, solo o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo en línea.
5531790.shortDescriptionEn: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

5532770.shortDescription: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.
5532770.shortDescriptionEn: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.

5533700.shortDescription: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.
5533700.shortDescriptionEn: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

5535320.shortDescription: 5434 artículos navideños están repartidos por la tienda. Devuélvelos a su sitio y disfruta del orden. Sin prisas ni agobios. Mejora tus habilidades con los caramelos que ganes y llena a tu gusto las estanterías de la enorme tienda de dos plantas con relucientes artículos navideños. ¡Feliz Navidad!
5535320.shortDescriptionEn: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!

5558370.shortDescription: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.
5558370.shortDescriptionEn: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

5568320.shortDescription: ¿Cuánto recuerdas del colegio? En este simulador de exámenes para un jugador, empieza con el pinyin y la aritmética y llega hasta la prueba de acceso a la universidad en China. Escribe redacciones, muestra tus cálculos y repasa los exámenes corregidos para ver dónde has ganado o perdido puntos.
5568320.shortDescriptionEn: How much do you remember from school? Start with pinyin and arithmetic, then work your way up to China's university entrance exam in this single-player exam simulator. Write essays, show your work in math, and open your marked papers to see where you earned or lost points.
